The brief

Arrange the outer sheet in tuck, back and front order, then create a readable three-panel itinerary on the inside.

The layout approach

A roll-fold travel brochure study balancing scenic imagery with practical copy.

  • Separate outer and inner sheet arrangements
  • Non-printing fold guides in the source document
  • Panel-based copy and proportionate image crops
